name: Ruthless Opportunist [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
Your timing and fierceness take the enemy by surprise.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): When an ally hits with an attack of opportunity against an enemy both you and that ally are threatening, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your melee attack rolls against that enemy for 1 round.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
